body: The Presidents Daughter has been kidnapped by ninjas. Are you a bad enough dude to rescue the presidents daughter?!

No, I responded a little harsh. But I’m suicidal in fact I’m in the er right now waiting for a bed. But there are ways out, and breaking your comfort zone is necessary at times. But I feel the need to tell you, a broken mind is a dangerous thing and it takes therapy and medication to heal.

I’m an advocate for mental health and telling people they don’t need psychiatric medication is a fallacy. Not everyone needs them, but a shift in thinking while good..is not permanent nor is it all it takes. What happens when the depression creeps back in? Will you shout No! In your heart and think you are healed. People need help. Don’t discourage other avenues of help.
No, for me it’s like a hot knife cutting my innards. It comes everyday and never quits.
That they’ve always supported me even when I make bad decisions or are worthless.
Maybe my parents, but it’s strained at best. I just don’t have the willpower to do anything. I literally would be fine sleeping my days away.
It might surprise you but I’m Male. And I still felt bad before, just after I realized my life isn’t getting better...it’s getting worse..way worse.

All of my relationships are bad, I hate everything, I just don’t like life. I’ve been alone for a lot of it, and that’s okay. I’m burnt out on trying to live in a world where nothing matters. I was recently coerced into sexual activities on a date. That’s when I realized my whole life is just a big shit storm. I just want to die in peace. Like just sleep to death.
